title: Clause from a linear constraint
statement: Given a constraint over $\mathbb{F}_2$ with three distinct variables and a right-hand side, and an index $j\in\{0,1,2,3\}$, form a three-literal Boolean clause on the same ordered variables. Its literal signs are those specified by the $j$th clause in the four-clause replacement of the linear constraint.
caveat: The upstream definition of the clause-sign function is absent, so its exact signs cannot be stated from the supplied snippet.
